mainEntity.name: What is an executive visibility agency and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: An executive visibility agency positions a founder or senior executive as the named authority in their category: securing op-ed bylines, journalist introductions, podcast appearances and AI-engine citations under their name. It is for Web3, AI and deep-tech founders who want investors, partners and buyers to recognise them as the credible voice in their space before any introductory call. Shilika Jain runs this as a fractional senior operator for $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does executive visibility work cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A traditional agency running a thought leadership programme typically charges $15K–$45K per month because it funds a content team, an account lead and a PR layer. A fractional senior operator delivers the same senior scope for $5K–$12K per month, and a focused launch sprint to build initial profile runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you actually place op-eds in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto opinion: CoinDesk Opinion, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks. Mainstream where the angle is strong enough: Forbes, Fast Company, VentureBeat, Yahoo Finance. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP (Japan), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA), and MENA publications for founders with a Middle East angle. Placement depends on a real point of view and a news hook, not a generic thought piece sent to a blast list.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build visible category authority?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first byline can land in four to six weeks once the positioning framework is set and the op-ed is written and pitched. Consistent category authority, where journalists and AI engines reliably associate your name with your topic, typically takes three to six months of sustained placements, podcast appearances and AI-citation structuring.

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current press footprint and where the positioning gaps are. Or book a 30-minute call and we will map it live. No deck required, no agency intro call.
